title: Adding times
summary: A struct with hours, minutes and seconds, a function that adds two of them, and the carry between fields.
hints: Use `struct time { int h, m, s; };` and a function `struct time add(struct time a, struct time b)` that adds field by field and then carries: `s >= 60` moves to `m`, `m >= 60` moves to `h`.
Read the lines with `fgets` and `sscanf(line, "%d:%d:%d", &t.h, &t.m, &t.s)`; it returns 3 when the line has the right shape. Print with `%d:%02d:%02d`.
